data.text: I’ll join Emma: I commit to catching 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided John and Jack also commit and Luke catches zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, and helping the clinic must come with keeping our recovery promise: 6 tons each next month, then 10 each once the stock returns to 100. John, are you in for both the donation and those limits?
